trust_decision.summary: Whether an inbound webhook delivered on a given path carries the Bearer secret TONAPI issued for that path's endpoint, decided inside TonapiWebhookDispatcher.process() by looking up a per-path token map that setup() only fills for the default suffix path.

landing_point.why: The advisory title says custom-path authentication bypass; this is the only authentication decision in the code, so an engineer who read only the summary lands on the token check in process().

fix_sites.entry_point: TonapiWebhookDispatcher.setup() (driven by account_tx(path=...), mempool_msg(path=...), opcode_msg(path=...), new_contracts(path=...), register(..., path=...))
TonapiWebhookDispatcher.process() via _build_path_map(), plus the new _endpoint_for_path() helper added at fix.diff:88-95
fix_sites.module_kind: library routing helper (path -> event type, path -> endpoint)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Tokens only exist for endpoints created by setup(); a path registered afterwards, or a dispatcher driven through the low-level TonapiWebhookClient without setup(), has no TONAPI-issued token to compare against, so 'there is nothing to verify' and the check is skipped.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: process() must keep dispatching events on paths that have no stored token (dispatcher constructed without a client, or used with tokens injected/absent), otherwise the project's own unauthenticated dispatch tests and the examples break; a fail-closed 'token required' check is an over-broad fix.

O6_input_shapes: handler registered with a custom path= (a single custom path per event type)
several distinct registered paths for the same event type (the set comprehension over handlers)
custom path supplied through register() as well as through the four decorators
dispatcher URL carrying a path prefix and/or query/params/fragment, normalised by the urlparse-based _endpoint_for_path()
teardown(cleanup=True) endpoint lookup for custom paths, not just the default suffix

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A handler registered after setup() via account_tx(path=...) or register(..., path=...) is added to the path map (_path_map reset) but _tokens has no entry for it, so process() resolves the event type and skips the token check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Registering after setup() is unusual and no TONAPI webhook/token exists yet for that path, so there is nothing to verify; the lifecycle method is the documented place where tokens appear.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, same package; registration API at pytonapi/webhook/dispatcher.py:238-260 is ~25 lines above the sink

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A dispatcher driven with the low-level TonapiWebhookClient (create()/ensure() plus TonapiWebhook objects) and no setup() keeps _tokens empty for every path, so every event dispatches unauthenticated.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The low-level client is documented as a separate layer for webhook CRUD; if the application builds its webhooks itself, the dispatcher was never told any token, so enforcing auth there is the application's job.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 file / 0 packages from the sink (pytonapi/webhook/client.py vs pytonapi/webhook/dispatcher.py)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second path->event-type builder (`paths`) that still returns only handlers[0][2], one path per event type.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: examples/webhook_fastapi.py:101-102 and docs/webhooks/overview.mdx:80-81 wire HTTP routes from dispatcher.paths, so a maintainer extending custom-path support would plausibly touch this property too and repeat the first-handler-only bug.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A persisted token store (JSON/config on disk) that setup() loads and process() reads, keyed by local path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: docs/webhooks/guide.mdx:166 says subscriptions persist across restarts, so caching the tokens beside them to avoid re-creating webhooks is a natural next feature; a token file missing a custom path reintroduces the same fail-open.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An ensure_by_path()-style client helper that matches webhooks by local path instead of full endpoint URL.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The published fix already needs path->endpoint conversion (_endpoint_for_path); moving that conversion into the client that calls ensure() is a plausible refactor.

O9_family: authentication bypass / fail-open secret verification (CWE-287): token map keyed by path is never populated for custom paths

O10_build.toolchain: setuptools>=80 via pyproject.toml, pip/venv; pytest + pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), ruff and mypy in the dev extra
O10_build.project_tests: tests/webhook/test_dispatcher.py (unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase; includes test_custom_path and test_token_validation) and tests/webhook/test_client.py; the dispatcher tests use fakes and need no network (as the fix's added test also does)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Take the check at its word and either reject a missing token in process() (fail closed) or stash the custom path's token from the registration decorator, instead of teaching setup() and _build_path_map() about every registered path.

out_of_scope_notes: Nothing outside this advisory's webhook-dispatch surface was pursued.
